theorems: The 13-mode Householder-plus-primitive-streaming candidate is exactly reversible and conserves the full relative quadratic on X6.
A dense stationary background f_v=beta, a=-6 beta is fixed; finite-norm deviations evolve losslessly.
For the no-return localized scatterer, E_visible(n)=4^{-n} and E_residual(n)=1-4^{-n} exactly, with no sink.
For finite directed cycles of length L, the same decay holds through n=L and the first return gives a_{L+1}=3/4+2^{-(L+1)}.
For the translation-invariant bulk candidate with zero residual input, the exact two-tick resolved map is T=I+Delta_X6/16, but P U^4 J != T^2; retained residual causes backflow.
No finite-dimensional closed unitary dilation can reproduce a strict contractive eigenmode T^n exactly for all n; side-4 X6 T has eigenvalue 7/8.
Per-slot positive residual energies do not determine the next visible energy: phase/sign-related states give 1/16 versus 9/16.
Under explicit quantum assumptions, a Bell joint relation is transported along any primitive X6 path by local SWAPs while total excitation, PPT negativity witness, and CHSH=14/5 are preserved.
nonclaims: The conserved quadratic is not identified with complete physical energy.
The Householder scatterer is a constitutive test law, not derived from P000.
Quantum tensor products, Born semantics and SWAP are explicit added assumptions; no quantum-origin theorem.
No exact all-time heat semigroup, viscosity, Navier-Stokes theorem, superluminal signal, independent review or Lean build.
